find: deaths.sort((a, b) => a.tick - b.tick || Number(b.id === trackedId) - Number(a.id === trackedId));
replace: deaths.sort((a, b) => Number(b.id === trackedId) - Number(a.id === trackedId));
why: Issue #925 review. Puts the tracked player's death first across the whole batch rather than among one tick's deaths, so in a catch-up frame a partner who died three ticks earlier lands inside the window the later death opened and is never named, though two single-tick frames would name both.
